text: Second repair: native identity now structurally encodes ValueIdentity, provenance ADTs, and all PlanReceipt fields through tagged length-prefixed AxisDigest input; native Observations withhold replay absent an explicit certificate. Tests add one-shot no-application rejection, value/provenance collision discrimination, equal reconstructed receipts and changed seed, a real typed SpaceEvidence frame payload plus failed entry, and intended String-to-Double compile-negative assertion. BoundScientificPlan syntax corrected after integrated compile feedback. Parent retains sbt gates.
